verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-transcription product, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted, on-premises or offline deployment of Otter. Every item describes cloud-hosted features, APIs, MCP and integrations. A community user voices concern about sending recordings to a cloud they don't control and wishes for a self-hosted option, which suggests none exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
